subject: Cloud catalog readiness: SOC2 / DPA / pen-test bundle for AWS + GCP co-sell
messages:
From: AWS Partner Team <aws-partner-team@amazon.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.example.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood catalog eligibility - evidence needed for co-sell enablement

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. The marketplace intake team is ready to move Redwood into the co-sell enablement queue, but we need a consolidated evidence package for the security & legal checks. For AWS and GCP listing we typically need:

- SOC 2 Type II summary and auditor contact
- Pen-test authorization/letter and a summary of findings (redacted)
- Signed DPA or confirmation that one can be executed before go-live
- Completed vendor security questionnaire (short form)

Can you send a single ZIP or a folder link with the items above and a short index file that maps each doc to the marketplace requirement? Also, do you have a preferred contact if the marketplace security SME wants to follow up?

Thanks,
Rebecca Chang
Sr. Partner Ops – AWS Marketplace
aws-partner-team@amazon.com

[Attachment: AWS-evidence-checklist-template.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example.com>
To: AWS Partner Team <aws-partner-team@amazon.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.example.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.example.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood catalog eligibility - evidence needed for co-sell enablement

Rebecca —

Appreciate the checklist. We're assembling an evidence bundle for both AWS and GCP listings. At a high level:

- SOC2 Type II: summary + auditor contact included.
- Pen test: we have an authorization letter and the executive summary of findings (sensitive details redacted).
- DPA: attached signed copy for review (redacted SPA fields for public distribution — full will be shared under NDA if needed).
- Vendor questionnaire: completed short-form attached.

I've attached an index CSV that maps each artifact to the marketplace ask. Priyom (Product Partnerships) will be your operational contact; Mina (Security) is on standby for any technical clarifications.

Next steps: please confirm if the index format is acceptable and whether the marketplaces want the full pen-test report under an NDA.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.example.com
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: marketplace-evidence-index.csv (csv)]
[Attachment: SOC2-TypeII-summary.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: Vendor-Questionnaire-Answers.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.example.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.example.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 15:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood catalog eligibility - evidence needed for co-sell enablement

Looping in a security note —

Laura / Priyom,

Attached the pen-test authorization we received from the vendor (Redwood paid engagement, third-party firm). For marketplace consumption I've included:

- Redwood-PenTest-AuthLetter-2026.pdf (authorization + redacted exec summary)
- A short FAQ on what we redact and why (internal)

If AWS/GCP require the full report we will provide it under an MSA/NDA route. Sergio — flagging this for legal redlines if marketplaces ask for contract updates.

Mina Haddad
Director, Security & Compliance
mina_haddad@redwood.example.com

[Attachment: Redwood-PenTest-AuthLetter-2026.pdf (pdf)]

From: AWS Partner Team <aws-partner-team@amazon.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example.com>
Cc: gcp-marketplace@google.com, security@datacloud.io
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 11:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood catalog eligibility - evidence needed for co-sell enablement

Thanks — this looks good. A couple of quick items before we mark the package complete:

- Can you upload the artifacts to a shared Drive link (with view-only) and send the index mapping as a single file?
- Marketplace security will likely request the full pen-test report for in-person review; please confirm the NDA/MSA contact and turnaround time.
- We also need a signed DPA in a form acceptable to AWS legal. The DPA you sent is fine as a placeholder but we may ask for a final signature flow via DocuSign.

If you can provide a single folder link and a DocuSign power-form for the DPA, we can proceed to the co-sell enablement queue this week.

Rebecca Chang
Sr. Partner Ops – AWS Marketplace

[Attachment: Request-For-Full-Report-template.txt (txt)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example.com>
To: AWS Partner Team <aws-partner-team@amazon.com>, gcp-marketplace@google.com
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.example.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.example.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.example.com>, security@datacloud.io
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood catalog readiness: SOC2 / DPA / pen-test bundle for AWS + GCP co-sell

Rebecca / Marketplace teams —

Thanks for the clear list. We've assembled a single, view-only folder and a consolidated index. Links and artifacts below:

- Evidence folder (view-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-marketplace-evidence
- DocuSign power-form (DPA signature): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcd-efgh
- HubSpot intake (for traceability): https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Included artifacts (in the folder):
- SOC2-TypeII-summary.pdf — auditor contact: KPMG (audit@kpmg.example.com)
- Redwood-PenTest-AuthLetter-2026.pdf — redacted executive summary included; full report available under NDA (contact: legal@redwood.example.com)
- Redwood-DPA-signed.pdf — interim signed copy; final signature via DocuSign link above
- Vendor-Questionnaire-Answers.xlsx — short vendor security questionnaire answers mapped to marketplace fields
- marketplace-evidence-index.csv — maps each item to marketplace requirement and internal owner

Next steps:
1) Marketplaces confirm receipt and whether they need the full pen-test (we will provide under NDA within 3 business days once DocuSign/MSA is in place).
2) Priyom will schedule a 30-minute follow-up to walk through the index and answer any operational questions.

If legal needs to discuss redlines (Sergio), please route to legal@redwood.example.com and flag the specific clause.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.example.com
Redwood Inference
